### Dominion Energy Expands Year-Round Assistance for Customers in South Carolina


10/12/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 548 KB](https://s205.q4cdn.com/611413639/files/doc_news/2026/10/12/Dominion-Energy-Expands-Year-Round-Assistance-for-Customers-in-South-Carolina.pdf)


*$3 million will support energy bill assistance and home weatherization improvements*


**CAYCE, S.C. (Oct. 12, 2026)** – Dominion Energy South Carolina is expanding its year-round assistance program with a three-year, $3 million commitment to help eligible customers with their energy bill and reduce monthly usage through weatherization and other energy efficiency upgrades.


As part of its commitment to customers, Dominion Energy dedicated additional shareholder-funded dollars to EnergyShare following stakeholder feedback earlier this year.


“EnergyShare is one of the ways we can lend a helping hand to our neighbors across the Palmetto State, including older adults and people living with disabilities, and reinforce our commitment to the customers and communities we’re privileged to serve,” said Kaytee Watson, manager of customer assistance for Dominion Energy South Carolina. “Whether it’s helping someone through a tough month or making lasting changes to their home that can help them use less energy for years to come, we are here to help.”


In addition to direct bill assistance and weatherization, EnergyShare supports critical health and safety repairs and energy-saving improvements for eligible Dominion Energy South Carolina residential electric customers. Since 2020, the program has helped more than 7,000 customers in South Carolina *.*


Program funds will be administered through the South Carolina Office of Economic Opportunity and community action agencies serving Dominion Energy South Carolina customers. To apply or learn more about EnergyShare and local community action agencies, visit[DominionEnergy.com/EnergyShareSC](http://dominionenergy.com/EnergyShareSC) .


**About Dominion Energy**


Dominion Energy (NYSE:[D](https://investors.dominionenergy.com/home/default.aspx) ), headquartered in Richmond, Va., provides regulated electricity service to[3.6 million](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company/operating-segments) homes and businesses in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, and regulated natural gas service to 500,000 customers in South Carolina. The company is one of the nation’s leading developers and operators of regulated[offshore wind](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/wind-power-facilities-and-projects/coastal-virginia-offshore-wind) and[solar](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/solar-energy-facilities-and-projects/virginia-solar-projects) power and the[largest producer of carbon-free electricity in New England](https://www.dominionenergy.com/projects-and-facilities/nuclear-facilities/millstone-power-station) . The company’s mission is to provide the[reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy](https://www.dominionenergy.com/our-company) that powers its customers every day. Please visit[DominionEnergy.com](http://www.dominionenergy.com/) to learn more.
